Colten Ellis makes 23 saves to lead the Sabres past the Sharks 2-0 — Colten Ellis made 23 saves in his first appearance in more than two weeks to lead the Buffalo Sabres to a 2-0 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night.

Hronek’s OT power-play goal caps the Canucks’ 6-5 comeback win over the Ducks — Filip Hronek scored a power-play goal with 11 seconds to go in overtime to cap a run of four consecutive goals by the Vancouver Canucks, who snapped a 10-game losing streak with a 6-5 comeback win over the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday night.

Islanders' Matthew Schaefer first on record to skate all 5 minutes of overtime Islanders star defenseman Matthew Schaefer on Tuesday night became the first skater on record to skate all five minutes of an overtime period.

Raphael Lavoie scores his 1st NHL goal as the Golden Knights beat the Senators 4-1 — Raphael Lavoie scored his first career goal, a tap-in eight minutes into the third period to put Vegas ahead for good in its 4-1 victory over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night, ending the Golden Knights' three-game losing streak.

Kaprizov scores his NHL-leading 14th goal as the Wild beat the Mammoth 3-1 — Kirill Kaprizov scored his NHL-leading 14th goal of the season and added an assist, Jesper Wallstedt stopped 26 of the 27 shots he faced, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Utah Mammoth 3-1 on Tuesday night.

Palmieri, Horvat score in shootout, Varlamov gets 1st win since 2024 as Islanders beat Predators 4-3 — Kyle Palmieri and Bo Horvat scored in a shootout to lead the New York Islanders to a 4-3 victory over the Nashville Predators on Tuesday night.

Aho's late goal helps Kochetkov improve to 8-0-0 as Hurricanes beat Bruins 2-1 — Sebastian Aho’s third-period goal gave the Carolina Hurricanes a 2-1 win over the Boston Bruins in a matchup of early leaders in the Eastern Conference on Tuesday night.

Jacob Fowler makes 46 saves for 2nd shutout of season as Canadiens beat Blues 2-0 — Jacob Fowler made a career-high 46 saves for his second shutout of the season, and Zachary Bolduc and Florian Xhekaj scored as the Montreal Canadiens defeated the St. Louis Blues 2-0 on Tuesday night.
